VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence confirms criterion (2) — all 88 tests pass — but provides nothing to verify criterion (1), that the token-refresh race condition is actually fixed. A passing test suite only demonstrates the bug is fixed if there is a test that specifically reproduces the race condition and now passes; race conditions are notoriously non-deterministic and frequently slip past existing test suites. There is no evidence of a new regression test targeting the race, no diff/code change shown, and no description of the root cause or fix. The self-report asserts the fix but does not substantiate it. Absent evidence that the specific defect is addressed, the acceptance criteria are not demonstrably met.
